items.title: Add iceberg_maintenance plugin worker handler (Phase 1)
items.body:
## Summary
- New `iceberg_maintenance` plugin worker job type that automates Iceberg table maintenance for S3 table buckets
- **Detection**: Scans table buckets, parses metadata from xattrs, evaluates snapshot count/age thresholds to identify tables needing work
- **Execution**: Runs operations in correct Iceberg maintenance order — expire snapshots → remove orphan files → rewrite manifests
- Uses iceberg-go v0.4.0 APIs (`ReadManifestList`, `ReadManifest`, `WriteManifest`, `WriteManifestList`, `MetadataBuilder.RemoveSnapshots`) for spec-compliant manifest I/O
- Optimistic concurrency commit protocol with exponential backoff + jitter retry on version conflict
- Configurable via admin config (bucket/namespace/table filters) and worker config (retention hours, max snapshots, orphan safety window, operations subset)
- Registered in worker runtime with aliases: `iceberg_maintenance`, `iceberg-maintenance`, `iceberg`
- Disabled by default; detection interval 1 hour when enabled

## Files changed
- `weed/plugin/worker/iceberg_maintenance_handler.go` — Handler implementation (~850 lines)
- `weed/plugin/worker/iceberg_maintenance_handler_test.go` — 11 unit tests
- `weed/command/worker_runtime.go` — Handler registration

## Test plan
- [x] All 11 new unit tests pass (`go test -v ./weed/plugin/worker/...`)
- [x] Existing plugin worker tests still pass
- [x] Full `go build ./weed/...` succeeds
- [ ] Integration test with a real table bucket (snapshot expiration, orphan removal, manifest rewrite)
- [ ] Verify detection correctly filters by bucket/namespace/table config
- [ ] Verify commit retry handles concurrent modifications
